Open Exhibition: Entry Confirmation
Thank you, Denise Aguilar. Your entry was received on January 24, and the works you submitted are listed below.
Title	Medium	Longest dimension
Harbor Morning	Oil on canvas	145 centimeters
Two Chairs	Watercolor	55 centimeters
You requested Section A for both works.
You asked to have your works listed in the exhibition catalog, and you told us that you will not need help carrying them in on hand-in day. You also confirmed that you will collect your works yourself after the exhibition closes, as every entrant must do within ten days of closing.
Please note the other conditions of entry. No entrant may submit more than two works in one year, and all works must arrive framed and ready to hang. Each work is shown in the section whose size range includes its longest side, and it is handed in only on the day listed for that section in the table below.
Section	Longest dimension	Hand-in day
A	Up to 70 centimeters	February 14
B	71 to 120 centimeters	February 16
C	121 to 180 centimeters	February 17
----------------------
To: Denise Aguilar
From: Owen Pritchard
Date: January 26
Subject: Open exhibition entry
Reference: Your online entry confirmation of January 24
Dear Ms. Aguilar,
Thank you for your entry, received here on January 24. Both works you listed have been accepted, and the change described below affects only one of them.
That work cannot be shown in the section you requested. Its longest side measures more than 120 centimeters, so it has been placed in the section for works of that size, and its hand-in day therefore changes. Please check the day shown for that section in the table on your confirmation page, and deliver the work on that day only.
Because you asked for a catalog listing, please also secure a typed caption card to the back of each frame.
Please confirm these arrangements by February 6. If you do not, the work will be held for a later exhibition.
Owen Pritchard
Exhibitions Officer
Eastcote Community Gallery
Desk hours 10 a.m. to 4 p.m., Tuesday to Friday. Telephone 555-0223, extension 18.

Reference: SS-3190 — Quarter reviewed: July to September
October 21
Mr. Simon Radcliffe, Orders Office, Pomeroy Provisions
Re: Delivery review, July to September
Dear Mr. Radcliffe:
In our check of your July to September deliveries, one of your four product groups fell below the standard we set, which is that at least 95 percent of deliveries in each group arrive on time.
Your account has therefore been moved to our watch list from the October to December quarter. Full standing returns once your combined share of on-time deliveries stays above 97 percent for two quarters in a row.
In the meantime, you may either keep an agreed amount of extra stock at our warehouse, so a late delivery does not empty our shelves, or accept a monthly check of your deliveries until your rate recovers. Please reply by October 31.
Sincerely,
Frances Ballard
Supplier Standards Manager
Extension 2210

Subject: Trentham review — which step to take
To: Marjorie Weaver — Copy: Orders Team Leader
The letter from Trentham came today. Our standing drops from the October to December quarter, so we must send back our choice soon.
The group that pulled our figures down is the one whose deliveries you handle every week. The summary makes that plain.
What worries me is the busy autumn. When orders climb in those weeks, getting our on-time share above the level Trentham now asks for is much harder, and I doubt we could keep it there for as long as the letter requires.
Could we meet for half an hour tomorrow to settle which of the two steps to pick before the reply date? Please bring the summary so we can go through each group.
Simon Radcliffe
Orders Office
Extension 3350
